input: Outline a children's book I want to illustrate

gold.taskTitle: Outline a Children's Book to Illustrate
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured outline for an original children's book that the user intends to illustrate themselves.

questions.title: What is the central story idea or premise?
questions.description: Understand the core concept, plot, or message the user wants the book to convey.

questions.title: Who is the target age group for this book?
questions.description: Identify the intended reader age range, as this affects vocabulary, page count, and story complexity.

questions.title: Who is the main character of the story?
questions.description: Gather details about the protagonist, such as whether they are a child, animal, or fantasy creature.

questions.title: What is the emotional theme or lesson you want to teach?
questions.description: Clarify the underlying message, such as courage, kindness, dealing with change, or self-acceptance.

questions.title: What illustration style are you planning to use?
questions.description: Understand the visual approach, such as watercolor, digital, collage, or pencil, to align the outline with the artistic direction.

questions.title: How many pages or spreads do you envision?
questions.description: Determine the intended length of the book to structure the outline into the right number of scenes or beats.

questions.title: Do you have a specific ending or resolution already in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user knows how the story concludes, which helps in reverse-engineering the outline structure.
